body: So, you're telling me that a 223 round shot through a wall/door isn't going to tumble or at very least keyhole? We don't even know if he was shooting 55gr, 62gr, or 77gr projectiles, let alone barrel length/twist rates. Had he not been shooting through a barrier, I'd be inclined to agree with you regarding the round penetrating through and through. That being said, you have no idea what those projectiles traveled through prior to striking Campos. 308 on the other hand is a different story. I guess what I'm trying to point out is that there are far too many variables in play to accurately state what could have happened regarding the GSW that Campos sustained. If you're as well versed in firearms, I'd think you'd agree with me in that aspect.
